label: copy-phase echo of k as the first original token (step L+1), long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the input is the letter k (100% of mass). 96% of the mass is at recall_idx 1, the step right after <DEL> where the model reads back its own first output, so in practice orig(0)=k. The rest is at recall_idx 2 when orig(1)=k. It also depends strongly on length: L=9 holds 85% of the mass, L=8 14%, L=7 under 1%, and L<=6 nothing (so to_go is about 6-7). Strongest examples are k-first sequences with L=9 where the next original token is 3, though output 3 alone does not pick out the active cases. Never fires on original-phase or delimiter steps, on any other token, or on later k echoes. Precision is low: most k-echo steps in long sequences stay below threshold, and I found no history variable that separates them.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=k (+3.36), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+2.85), phase=2 & out_tok=3 (+2.80), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=k (+2.63), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+2.44), orig0=k (+2.08).
